TO_CHAR( START_DATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS EVENT_DATE,
TO_CHAR( START_DATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS START_DATETIME,
TO_CHAR( END_DATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS END_DATETIME,

WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
AND TRUNC(START_DATETIME) = TO_DATE( #{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
